en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin isa, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Abdullah Bin Maymoun Al Qaddah, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The supplication and pleading before Allah for help is the means of its acceptance just as clouds are means of rain’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Hassan ibn Ali from ‘Abd Allah ibn Maymun al-Qaddah from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘
Prayer and pleading before Allah for help is the means for its acceptance just as clouds are means of rain.’”
